name: STOCKMIND Tactical — Aug 2026
regime: Late-cycle, narrow tech-led uptrend; weak breadth (22% >MA150); HYG below MA150; hawkish Fed; 10Y 4.67%, oil $84; Fear sentiment (F&G 39); weak USD, gold/copper firm; strong earnings (86% beat).
philosophy: Stay invested in the uptrend but don't chase mega-tech. Overweight the historically best diversifier (gold), tilt equity to quality/defensive that is actually leading (healthcare), hold real T-bill carry as dry powder into the PCE/GDP gate, avoid long duration and junk credit.

rebalance_triggers.add_risk: Breadth (% >MA150) climbs above ~40 AND HYG reclaims its MA150 → rally broadening; rotate cash into VOO/QQQM.

rebalance_triggers.gold_stop: Gold closes decisively below its 200-day MA → trim the gold sleeve (structural break in the hedge).
